title: The Cover of Kowloon
author: Petra Coldharbour
blurb: Vesper Dravenmoor, an interpreter attached to a peace delegation destined to fail, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. But when a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must extract a defector who may be the bait, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
